desc: Confirm equivalence: N is a 400 number iff N=M^2 and M has exactly two distinct prime factors.
Implement omega sieve up to 10^6 and predecessor array pref for largest M≤i with omega(M)==2.
Answer each query with m=isqrt(A) and output pref[m]^2.
Handle fast I/O for Q up to 2×10^5.
Test edge cases (A=36, 60, 404, 10^12, 123456789); all sample outputs match.
